stemMd: Two parallel lines are crossed by a transversal. One acute angle measures $3x+8$ degrees and an obtuse angle measures $5x+12$ degrees. What is $x$?
explanationMd: With parallel lines, an acute and an obtuse angle formed by the transversal are supplementary. Thus 3x+8+5x+12=180, giving 8x=160 and x=20. The angles are 68 and 112 degrees.

distractorRationale.c: This ignores the constant terms in their sum.
distractorRationale.d: This divides by the wrong combined coefficient.
distractorRationale.a: This sets the acute and obtuse measures equal rather than supplementary.
